messages.subject: Proceedings issued - Claim No. HT-2025-000318
messages.plaintextBody:
Gavin,

We issued the Particulars of Claim in the Technology and Construction Court today. The claim number is HT-2025-000318 and the claim is for £3,485,000 plus interest and costs. A sealed copy will follow once we have it back from the court.

Melbourne Sealtech now has to file a defence. We'll keep you posted.

Best,
Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
